newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values rise.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values rise.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 20 - FOB Gulf basis values for soft red winter wheat were several cents higher late Friday in reaction to gains in CIF values, dealers said.
Dealers said the CIF gains appeared to be related to shippers wanting to ensure they had an available supply of high quality wheat rather than to a rise in export demand.
Corn basis values were steady to firm with light demand noted for nearby positions. Soybean values were mostly unchanged.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
